ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Maps Bridge uses your location while you use the app to power “Near me” and show where you are on the map. Your location is not stored on our servers.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access lets you take photos for your community posts and scan shared 6-digit location QR codes.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo access lets you add images to community posts and your profile picture.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: This permission lets you save route and map images to your photo library.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Used to unlock the app with Face ID when you turn on the app lock.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Maps Bridge does not collect your motion data on servers; the accelerometer is only used on-device for optional Shake-to-SOS (112 emergency) detection and the location component system library.
